description: Parameter provenance for the independent reconstruction. This is not a battery telemetry dataset or the original study configuration.

provenance_legend.manuscript_reported: Value stated in the current manuscript; not independently confirmed against the unavailable original source code.
provenance_legend.not_reported_in_manuscript: The original manuscript does not specify this value; null means the reconstruction must choose an assumption.
provenance_legend.reconstruction_code_defaults_not_validat: Value used by the current reconstruction only; not evidence of the setting used for the manuscript's original reported runs.

reconstruction_code_defaults_not_validat.source: code/agingbid/core.py defaults; separate charge/discharge vectors currently have equal assumed values, not measured battery data

additional_reconstruction_choices_not_va.reserve_cap_interpretation: The code applies the 1.5 MW cap separately to upward and downward reserve; the manuscript does not unambiguously establish whether the cap is per direction or aggregate.
additional_reconstruction_choices_not_va.reserve_prices: Four-hour block means repeated across the hours of each block; not interval-level auction or settlement data.
additional_reconstruction_choices_not_va.imbalance_settlement: Deterministic proxy in code/agingbid/core.py; not observed reBAP.
additional_reconstruction_choices_not_va.scenario_generation: Historical daily block resampling with the implementation and seed documented in the diagnostic commands; not the unavailable original scenario archive.
additional_reconstruction_choices_not_va.charge_discharge_exclusivity: The default LP relaxation allows simultaneous charging and discharging; use --exclusive for the binary MILP.
